usedFor: Barevalue handles AI podcast editing orders; Asana tracks the production work. A “New Failed Order” or “New Completed Order” in Barevalue can start a project through “Create Project” in Asana.

bestTemplate.name: “New Failed Order” in Barevalue, then “Create Project” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: A failed check or processing error needs a person, so it gets a project with an owner and due date. Completed orders rarely need one.

watchOut: “Create Project” needs a workspace and a name. If you attach it to “New Completed Order” as well, every finished episode creates its own project.
